reviews.title: Re-verify AS2 Areas 1-7 against current code and shared tests
reviews.summary: Executable audit of AS2 Areas 1-7 demotes unwired TextRenderer, Stage.wmodeGPU, showRedrawRegions and NetStream publishing stubs plus incomplete Boolean/MovieClip/ContextMenu/Selection/NetStream options to missing or partial, and documents notes on setMask.

entries.note: Primitive Boolean(v) conversion works; new Boolean(v) throws unsupported boxed Boolean construction.
Applies live MovieClip vector masks; string target paths and authored alpha or gradient masks reject or stay unsupported.
Reads and axis-aligned writes work; setting _width on rotated or skewed clips throws RangeError.
Reads and axis-aligned writes work; setting _height on rotated or skewed clips throws RangeError.
Supports standard Canvas2D blend modes; subtract, invert, alpha, erase and shader reject in as2_render.rs.
Draws width, color and alpha; hairline <= 0 throws RangeError and pixelHinting, scaleMode, caps, joints and miterLimit are dropped.
Hardcodes false without GPU wmode compositing.
Supports play, rewind, forward_back and print toggles; zoom, quality and loop throw unavailable errors.
Focuses live MovieClip or TextField instances and null; string target paths throw unsupported.
Mutates redraw_regions flag in as2_settings with zero readers in web rendering or runtime.
Stores rendererState properties and tables never read by Canvas text rendering.
Stores displayMode in rendererState without affecting Canvas text rendering.
Stores maxLevel in rendererState without affecting Canvas text rendering.
Validates and stores table entries never read by AS2 text rendering.
Hardcodes 0 without live RTMP buffer latency.
Always emits NetStream.Publish.BadName because RTMP media server publishing is absent.
Stores Microphone reference only without RTMP audio encoding or transmission.
Stores Camera reference only without RTMP video encoding or transmission.
Reports buffer lengths while byteCounts, throughput, srtt, droppedFrames and isLive are hardcoded 0 or false.
